verdict.rationale: The evidence shows single-URL fetching ('converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown'), web search, and concurrent browser sessions. None of it documents a crawl capability that discovers and returns every page of a site from one request. Single-page fetch and session concurrency are adjacent building blocks, not site-wide crawling, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can crawl an entire website and get content from all its pages with one request
